title: Enhanced 1,2-propanediol production from glycerol using bimetallic Ni–Cu catalysts on different supports
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5657-5672
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00480B, Paper
A. Ghorbani, P. Boahene, A. K. Dalai
Ni–Cu/AlO(OH) exhibited excellent performance, attributed to the well-dispersed Ni and Cu nanoparticles on AlO(OH), the mesoporous structure with large pores, and the abundance of acid sites on the catalyst.
